summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of LocalConnect Lite MVP. All 18 pytest API tests passed (auth, posts, likes, area isolation, case-insensitive area matching, validation). All critical UI flows verified end-to-end: unauthenticated redirect to /login, demo login prefill, signup with new area, area-banner, feed list (seeded posts with offer highlighting), create normal + offer posts, like toggle, profile page with stats, nav (feed/profile/logout), protected route redirection, and area isolation (new-area user sees empty feed).

ui_bugs.issue: When feed is empty (new user in new area), data-testid='feed-empty' is not rendered; only a loading spinner remains briefly visible. The explicit empty state testid is not shown in DOM despite posts=[].

issues: Toast notifications render over the top-right Header nav buttons and can visually obscure Profile/Logout icons for ~2s after posting. Functionally still clickable with force=True, but a real user might mis-click. Consider offsetting toast position or moving nav buttons to avoid overlap.

action_items: (LOW) Ensure data-testid='feed-empty' renders when posts list is empty after loading completes (Feed.jsx)
(LOW) Consider repositioning toast notifications so they don't overlap header nav buttons
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — switch to lifespan context manager for future FastAPI versions.
JWT_SECRET is committed in backend/.env file (checked-in). Fine for MVP, but in production must move to secret manager.

CORS: allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; browsers may reject credentialed requests. Currently app uses Authorization header (not cookies) so it works, but worth tightening.
create-index runs on every startup via on_event — idempotent but OK. Seed logic is correctly idempotent (checks for existing user/posts before insert).

Post content is trimmed but Pydantic min_length=1 validation runs before trim. A string of only whitespace like '   ' passes validation and is then stripped to empty. Consider validator to reject whitespace-only.
GET /api/posts limited to 200 with no pagination — acceptable for MVP.
test_credentials: Demo users seeded: aanya@demo.com / demo123, rohan@demo.com / demo123, priya@demo.com / demo123 (all in Koramangala). JWT token stored in localStorage key 'lc_token'.
seed_data_creation: Test script creates TEST_ prefixed users/posts via public API; no cleanup implemented as data is namespaced by area and does not affect demo area tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_localconnect.py is the regression reference. Reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or falls back to frontend/.env. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend testids are comprehensive and stable; use data-testid selectors for everything. Core flows all verified working.
